description:
For Lee Jae-Young, room 1305 has been the one constant in his life. He’s lived there since childhood, and it has remained the same even while everything around him has changed. So, you’d think that when his old upstairs neighbor returns, Jae-Young wouldn’t feel any different. In many ways, the tall and confident Lee Tae-Young is nothing like the sweet kid Jae-Young once knew. But, there’s some habits that no amount of time apart can seem to shake. Sure, Tae-Young had always been a little possessive of Jae-Young’s attention, but after what happened…. surely he must have grown out of that by now?! Nevertheless, Tae-Young is certainly no longer the innocent kid that Jae-Young once knew, and now he’s determined to weasel his way back into Jae-Young’s life. From old friendships to hardcore sex, what else will happen in room 1305? 

(Source: Lezhin US)
